title: German perforated metal found at Roswell

tellings.quote: a kind of perforated metal which later was discovered uh at Roswell

plain: A kind of perforated metal, meaning metal full of tiny holes, that Germany developed in the 1940s was later found at Roswell, the New Mexico town where a reported crash in 1947 became the most famous UFO story. The writer Jason Jorjani says this on Michels's show, drawing on the former Army officer Philip J. Corso. If it is true, it would link the Roswell debris to secret wartime German technology.
